answer_2.quote: We follow previous works and adopt mean absolute error (MAE), Pearson correlation (Corr), seven-class classification accuracy (ACC-7), binary classification accuracy (ACC-2) and F1 score ... For MELD and IEMOCAP, we use accuracy (ACC) and weighted F1 (WF1) for evaluation.

answer_4.quote: We randomly selected 80 samples with universal labels from MOSI and manually evaluated the generated labels used for universal label completion; the accuracy is about 90%.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators checked the correctness of the automatically completed universal labels and reported the accuracy.
